    Local families with exact right meshes #

    The structure of C = gr_J ind(mod A) used in the proof of Proposition 2.10: the positive-degree ideal is the categorical radical, it is nilpotent, each degree-zero endomorphism ring is k, and degree-zero maps between distinct objects vanish (Lemma 2.7); the right mesh map at each label has image the radical (Lemma 2.7), and at a nonprojective label the right mesh is exact in both variables (Proposition 2.6(1)); at a projective label the mesh map is monic (Proposition 2.6(2)).

    We record these properties for a finite family of objects of a k-linear category (LocalFamily, MeshData), and derive the module-theoretic consequences over the category algebra Λ.
